obligations.rationale: Brief-led subject content includes volunteer precipitation QC and environmental time-series products/workflows, plus unfamiliar metadata/provenance/tabular mechanisms and local components. CoCoRaHS manual QC is a directly relevant tool/workflow precedent; tool interaction and alternative breadth are thin. No exhaustive opportunity recall or lifecycle ordering proof is claimed.

Pinned actual reader/deserializer/core source, defaults, caller, state definition, tests and version correction are inspected; consequential width claims are correct and diagnostic limits explicit. C02 locator error is nonmaterial because the correct bytes/full source/C10 survive.

Allowed equivalent implementation-evolution route has fix message/patch, added regression and release ancestry/source. Byte-buffer Serde relevance is conditional and retained. Open position reports are not represented as fixed/shipped; exact 1.4.0 physical-line behavior remains unexecuted, not satisfied merely by uncertainty.
Every frozen P1–P6 decision is compared, retained/specified/deferred/qualified with exact section references; no whole-project cross-reference is inferred.

All C1–C5 substantive criticisms and the erroneous C08 version-label correction have explicit dispositions and implemented textual consequences. Flash-family identity is host provenance and cannot be independently inferred from scientific source content.

One coherent authoritative replacement artifact covers intake, model, review, comparison, operation/export, alternatives, negative/already-covered dispositions, open choices, criticism and concrete proposed validation.

CSV desktop imports for ten stations/one season; station/sensor identity and time/unit preview; immutable originals and visible batch provenance. Retained and specified with profiles/source identity. Saved profile versions are additions, not evidence that baseline profiles existed.

Local raw samples/import decisions/separate annotations; station location/replacement metadata; overlapping imports shown for review rather than silent replacement. Retained with effective-dated/append-only provenance and separate recovery. Overlap review is preserved in line 91 of the comparison table.

Aligned storm-window rain/stage plots; missing intervals and suspect annotations; configurable thresholds/manual review; no autonomous correction or level-to-flow. Retained; prompts explicitly uncalibrated/contextual, status does not certify measurements.

Nearby and user-selected reference comparisons; raw source and selected interpretations shown; summaries link to selected sample ranges. Retained with support/units/boundary/coverage and no silent transformations.

Single-user local app, embedded store/scientific reader/plot undecided; about two million seasonal records on a normal laptop; offline use/no cloud account. Constraints retained; candidate store/parser selected, remaining plot/time dependencies and quantitative limits explicitly deferred rather than claimed validated.

Selected-window review package with provenance/annotations/uncertainty; repeated imports/discontinuous records/metadata changes/round-trip acceptance; no tests run. Retained; bytes versus references, unresolved review context and eight proposed validation groups are explicit.

checks.title: Original product scope and negative boundaries
checks.conclusion: One watershed/season, six rain gauges/four level stations, measured-versus-interpreted preservation, local single-user workflow, no warnings/forecasting are preserved. Additional no-causal/no-agency-certification boundaries are conservative product choices, not claims of original explicit wording.

checks.title: HydroShare environmental time-series storage precedent
checks.conclusion: Primary documentation describes fixed-point observations, ODM2 SQLite and CSV upload with metadata creation. It supports an environmental-observation precedent, not an offline product dependency.

checks.title: HydroShare metadata and temporal support
checks.conclusion: Site, variable, method, processing level, units, aggregation statistic and UTC offset are explicitly documented. Unknown datum/reference and interval boundaries remain product decisions. These metadata fields motivate interpretation; they do not validate local instruments or aggregation.

checks.title: USGS stage/elevation process and limits
checks.conclusion: Stage documents cover field verification, backup-source provenance, edit/correction rationale and times, estimates, review and approval. They are agency procedures; the final explicitly declines their approval terminology and local-threshold transfer.

checks.title: USGS precipitation process and distinct scope
checks.conclusion: Precipitation guidance distinguishes permanent records, calibration, backups, edits, corrections, estimates and hyetographic comparison; it can include deleting erroneous data. The final borrows evidence categories and expressly does not transfer agency procedures.

checks.title: CoCoRaHS volunteer entry motifs and ordered downstream flags
checks.conclusion: The 2019 primary guide documents decimal/date/false-zero/multi-day/snow-field reporting mistakes, manual spatial comparison and ordered downstream QA flags. These justify contextual review prompts; they do not establish thresholds for this network.

locator.heading_or_section: QC Manual Process; Common Types of Errors; GHCN-D QA, PDF pp. 3–5

checks.title: CoCoRaHS overflow retention wording
checks.conclusion: The guide welcomes extreme reports with comments but states that uncommented 11/12-inch amounts are changed to NA during QC pending follow-up. The final retention wording omits that governing condition. This is not an established unchanged-value preservation mechanism. The final does not adopt CoCoRaHS mutation policy; its non-destructive behavior is independently required by the brief, so this does not invalidate a product decision.

checks.title: PROV conceptual provenance subset
checks.conclusion: Entity/activity/agent/use/generation/derivation concepts are present in the recommendation. The app relational subset is a proposal, not claimed PROV compliance.

checks.title: CSVW user-supplied interpretation metadata
checks.conclusion: CSVW §5.1 supports user-supplied overriding metadata and processor options; the dialect/data model supports explicit tabular interpretation. Named/versioned application profiles are a design addition rather than a standard-mandated implementation.

checks.title: ODM2 subset and optional interoperability
checks.conclusion: Current-schema index contains Actions, Results, Annotations, RelatedResults, ResultDerivationEquations and DataQuality relationships. Full schema/RDF adoption is expressly deferred. No compliant export is claimed.

checks.title: SQLite local application-store fit
checks.conclusion: SQLite official guidance supports desktop application-file/local data use. It does not establish this workbench performance or a final SQLite version/configuration.

checks.title: Foreign-key activation and governing conditions
checks.conclusion: Foreign keys require a build with the relevant support, runtime activation on every connection and verification; enabling inside an active multi-statement transaction is ineffective. The final requires activation/verification per connection and has not selected a runtime build.

checks.title: Database atomicity versus file/database recovery
checks.conclusion: SQLite atomicity concerns database transactions; the cited explanation is rollback-mode-specific and separately acknowledges WAL atomicity. The staged external-file recovery sequence is application policy, not a tested guarantee. Hash/fsync/rename/durable recovery remain configuration-dependent implementation work.

checks.title: csv 1.4.0 exact released source
checks.conclusion: GitHub tag API resolves to the claimed commit dated 2025-10-17. The actual crates.io 1.4.0 package records that commit in .cargo_vcs_info.json and contains byte-identical reader/deserializer source. A repository commit is therefore connected to a published package here; this is not inferred merely from a merged change.

checks.title: ReaderBuilder strict default and flexible mode
checks.conclusion: ReaderBuilder::default sets flexible=false. ReaderBuilder::flexible documents and configures equal-field-count checking; true disables that check, not semantic validation.

checks.title: First record, headers and schema meaning
checks.conclusion: ReaderState::add_record captures the first parsed field count; read_byte_record handles whether that first record is returned as data or used as a header. Column existence/duplicates/semantic requirements need application checks.

checks.title: Error position, governing caller and source-map range
checks.conclusion: read_byte_record_impl initializes record position, consumes core output, updates byte/line state and invokes add_record. UnequalLengths clones the record position and reports widths. C02 bytes actually cover reader.rs 1648–1675, whereas its map says 1578–1613. C10 and the full S16 capture preserve the needed implementation, so behavior evidence remains sound.

checks.title: Width and continued-reading upstream tests
checks.conclusion: The source tests cover unequal width, expected/error position, flexible acceptance and continued reading after a width error. They were inspected, not run by candidates or reviewer; they do not prove this app or all diagnostic cases work.

checks.title: Issue #395 exact diagnostic conditions
checks.conclusion: The primary issue is open and supplies a CRLF-terminator/no-header reproducer for Reader position; comments also report record-position effects. Pinned wrapper/core line state is relevant. No local release-specific execution or shipped fix is claimed. App-owned identity and separate line-display checks are a reasonable conservative disposition.

checks.title: Issue #422 qualification and release timing
checks.conclusion: Issue #422 is open and postdates 1.4.0. A follow-up reproduces the output with equal widths and explains next-line/end-of-input behavior, changed by a trailing newline. It is not strong evidence of a column-mismatch-caused defect. The final correctly does not assert a proven pinned defect/fix, but loses this useful qualification.

checks.title: Critic csv-core package-version correction
checks.conclusion: Pinned in-tree csv-core Cargo.toml says 0.1.13; root path dependency requires 0.1.11, a compatible version requirement rather than equality. The published package lock records 0.1.13 but is not a consuming app runtime lock. The final properly rejects C08’s exact 0.1.11 package label.

checks.title: 2018 invalid-UTF-8 fix mechanism and applicability
checks.conclusion: The fix message/patch change deserialize_byte_buf from a string-validating helper to raw field bytes. The governing ByteRecord wrapper and DeByteRecord helpers confirm the distinction. This matters only when byte-buffer Serde is actually used; manual field mapping does not establish it. No encoding-detection/normalization property follows.

checks.title: Equivalent defect/fix/regression/release chain
checks.conclusion: The selected component has concrete maintainer-described defect/fix history, added regression code and released-source ancestry. The published 1.4.0 package retains the fixed path and evolved regression test. This is sufficient for the brief’s allowed equivalent implementation-evolution route, narrowly tied to raw-byte-capable deserialization; it does not close the unrelated physical-line issues or establish usage in this proposed manual mapper.

checks.title: Immutable intake, duplicates and overlapping imports
checks.conclusion: The full final retains raw bytes, raw text, profile versions, distinct interpretations and duplicate candidates. P2’s overlap review is retained in the comparison table (line 91), although not re-expanded in replacement P2. Credit comes from the authoritative artifact as a whole; no implementation exists.

checks.title: Station metadata, append-only review and alternate interpretations
checks.conclusion: Stable identity, sensor replacement/effective dates, unknown datum/reference, historical revisions, append-only annotations and separately recorded human alternate values meet preservation needs. Whether alternate values belong in the MVP remains an explicit option.

checks.title: Non-destructive prompts and comparison applicability
checks.conclusion: Manual review/configurable prompts, gaps, statuses and no autonomous replacement are retained. Cross-station disagreement requires interpreted support/reporting periods/units and is not treated as proof readings are false. No local thresholds are calibrated.

checks.title: Rain totals, stage maxima and summary lineage
checks.conclusion: Known suitable interval accumulations, explicit boundaries/partial coverage, no rate summing or overlap double-counting, stage maximum plus time and exact input linkage address temporal ambiguity. These are proposed calculation contracts, not executed hydrologic validation or a flow/forecast claim.

checks.title: P5 candidates, remaining components and performance
checks.conclusion: Single-user/local/offline/no-account conditions are preserved. SQLite/csv are candidates; plotting and scientific time/time-zone dependencies remain explicitly undecided pending representative-data interaction and scale work. The two-million-row target has no measured result or invented latency threshold; a named machine and owner-defined limits are still needed.

checks.title: Review package, source-byte choice and uncertainty
checks.conclusion: Selected window, provenance, annotations, raw versus interpreted values, flags, summaries, hashes, time/support/unit/coverage and uncertainty are carried. Optional source inclusion and omitted-source inspectability limits are explicit. Round-trip/offline reopening is a proposed acceptance case.

checks.title: Proposed versus executed validation and witness applicability
checks.conclusion: Eight detailed validation groups retain original repeated-import/discontinuous/history/round-trip acceptance and add diagnostics, decoding, support/units, flags, summary, source portability, recovery and scale conditions. No application/parser/regression runtime test, benchmark or fault injection witness is supplied or claimed. Source capture, static code/test inspection and ancestry are evidence checks, not product validation.

critic_dispositions.result: Width-only claim, app-owned ordinal/offset, strict/flexible cases, line-number separation, headers/extra cells and explicit invalid-byte handling retained; no fixed/shipped assertion.
Support/statistic/time-zone/boundaries, no silent alignment, no rate summing/overlap double-counting and stage max/time retained.
Unsupported named-station assertion corrected and real names/metadata remain unknown.
DB-only transaction boundary, file staging/reconciliation and unexecuted recovery tests retained.
Optional original-file inclusion/inspectability limit and named-machine/product-defined benchmark criteria retained.
Actual in-tree version 0.1.13 distinguished from compatible 0.1.11 path requirement; no false exact-version disposition.

bounded_opportunities.title: ODM Tools Python direct desktop precedent
bounded_opportunities.conclusion: Primary README describes query/visualize/edit of observational time series, but identifies legacy Python 2.7 and ODM 1.1.1 compatibility. A useful historical workflow/negative lead omitted from final, not an adoption recommendation or proof of current usability. No required obligation demands this exact product.

bounded_opportunities.title: CZ Manager raw/derived review mechanism
bounded_opportunities.conclusion: Primary guide describes copying raw series, selecting points, annotations/quality levels and changes to derived values. The final independently has separate human interpretation/annotations; this is a missed concrete tool analogy, not a required automatic-editing feature.

bounded_opportunities.title: CoCoRaHS comparison tool and QC-ticket workflow
bounded_opportunities.conclusion: The admitted primary guide explicitly describes a surrounding-observation web tool, maps and QC tickets/follow-up. Final prompts/review context use this direct-workflow analogy at a bounded minimum, but do not describe tool interactions/ticket mechanism in depth. External outreach is not proposed or performed.

actual_executed_review_checks: Read complete brief, frozen plan and three full authored artifacts; inspected all substantive source-map entries while ignoring lifecycle/timing/counter fields.
Retrieved public primary documentation, immutable component code, published csv package, fix/tag/compare metadata and issue bodies/comments.
Compared candidate reader/deserializer captures with immutable upstream and published-package bytes; matched all eleven critic code/manifest snippets to exact upstream contiguous ranges.
Extracted PDF/HTML text and inspected governing passages, metadata/version headings and PDF page structure.
Inspected static upstream test code and fix diff without running downloaded code.
not_executed: Fault injection or filesystem durability witness
source_truth_policy: Candidate narrative, source maps, declared hashes and exit status were navigation aids only. Claims were judged using primary bytes, governing code and context. Hashes identify evidence; they are not evidence that an interpretation is correct.
blinding_limits: Admitted input paths visibly identify treatment.
Researcher draft and source maps expose method-specific native-Goal/lifecycle/timing/counter prose; ignored for science.
No counterpart artifacts/grades, parent analysis, evaluator answers, campaign state/selection/locks or other reviews were accessed.
host_provenance_excluded: Flash-family/provider identity and procedural ordering were not independently established from source content and are left to the host; they neither award nor remove SourcePASS.

delivery_validation.note: Artifact consistency check only, not product/source execution proof.
